models.title: Income-statement common-size fraction
models.summary: Income-statement common-size fraction expresses income-statement line item relative to revenue.

relationship.original_equation: Income-statement common-size fraction = income-statement line item / revenue
relationship.translation_notes: Currency cancels and the output is a base-one fraction. The gross, operating, pretax and net margins are meaningful named selections of the comparison item; each is also described separately. The owner PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation source; relationship locator identifies the accessible corroborating source.

variables.definition: Positive revenue for the same entity and reporting period

variables.definition: income-statement line item as a fraction of revenue
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: The numerator and revenue use the same currency, entity, accounting basis and period.
Revenue is positive in this analytical profile.
limitations: Changes in classification or reporting scope can affect comparisons across statements.
Negative numerator values are permitted; percent display is not part of the calculation.
